item.title: Boeing will open 737 Max line in Everett by ‘midsummer’
item.description: Boeing will open its fourth Max production line in Everett, Washington, this summer, setting a timeline that the Everett community has been waiting to hear for two years.

item.title: WA Senate OKs bill to better define ‘election’
item.description: Washington lawmakers moved a step closer Tuesday to make clear it is illegal to vote twice in an election, even if the ballots are cast in different jurisdictions.

item.title: Video in investigation into Nancy Guthrie’s abduction raises questions about surveillance technology
item.description: Tuesday’s release of video surveillance footage showing an armed, masked person at Nancy Guthrie’s doorstep on the night she was abducted has raised a host of questions about why it took so long to publicly release, how it was retrieved and what it means for privacy.

item.title: Crystal Mountain night skiing dates, hours get reduced
item.description: Night skiing at Washington's largest ski resort will see changes through the end of the season.

item.title: Two Texas men guilty of robbing banks in Vancouver and locations across the country
item.description: Two Texas men recently pleaded guilty in a cross-country bank robbery scheme that involved assaulting and threatening ATM technicians to steal cash, including in Vancouver, according to a news release from the U.S. Department of Justice.

item.title: Hockinson school levy passing in initial election returns
item.description: Hockinson School District’s replacement school programs and operations levy was passing in early election returns Tuesday night.

item.title: Battle Ground’s third try at school levy falls short
item.description: Battle Ground Public Schools’ replacement educational programs and operations levy was failing in early election returns Tuesday night.

item.title: Washougal school levies passing in early returns
item.description: Washougal’s school funding measures were prevailing in early election returns Tuesday night.

item.title: Kimora Ross adds to Evergreen basketball legacy with third league title in four years
item.description: As a freshman, Kimora Ross helped Evergreen girls basketball win its first league title since 1980. Tuesday on senior night, Ross climbed the ladder and cut down the nets for the third time in four years. Evergreen clinched the 3A Greater St. Helens League title with a 76-44 win over Kelso.

item.description: Tuesday’s high school sports results for boys and girls basketball and girls bowling.
